settings.prompt:
Copyedit this sentence for a scientific journal. Preserve its facts, names and numbers. Keep technical terms. Reword {extent}. Return exactly one complete sentence of {minimum} to {maximum} words with no labels, quotes or comments.

{sentence}

method.baseline: Use exact native three-sentence context responses at the current raw 0.50 point, first six in source order. Direct candidate output means exact complete focus. Selection and hit accounting use at least 50% non-whitespace character recall and 0.30 intersection over union.
method.causal_input: Use the full same three-sentence native excerpt and one installed Apache-2.0 1.5B base model quantized to four bits in memory. Measure the exact source focus and other causally complete sentences from the same forward. A token cannot have any non-whitespace character outside its assigned sentence. A sentence requires all its non-whitespace characters and a predictive prefix. Include actual token ranks, log ranks, surprisal, expected surprisal and native position records.
method.gate: Clipped log rank is primary. Require at least three genuinely additional useful held works across both generators, at least six held cases per generator, no loss of current useful locations, and at most one additional genuine work flagged by the union. Otherwise retain research only. No confidence contribution follows.
method.generation_admission: Fresh attempts use the same earlier publisher sentence for both pinned Apache-2.0 generators. From up to eight attempts keep the earliest complete, noncopied one-sentence result with unchanged native flanks, the exact multiset of numbers, within three lexical words of the natural later sentence, and normalized reference-relative word edit distance within 0.15 of the natural revision. A verified publisher pair is a genuine control, and historical editing-tool use and all generated semantic fidelity remain unverified.
method.negative: The two prior mixed-PDF misses are exposed diagnostic inputs only. They never set clipping or operating points. Do not describe this targeted English panel as an overall writing false-positive rate.
method.operating_point: Each causal arm uses strict excess over the second-highest genuine selection work maximum across unchanged and naturally revised variants. Select up to two highest eligible source-sentence foci, breaking tied values by abstaining at the tied rank. Include unchanged, naturally revised and all admitted generated held variants. Report paired exact-focus ranking independently of operating points.
method.purpose: Localize AI-generated replacement sentences in mixed English journal passages against substantial, source-matched genuine publisher revisions.
method.scores: Raw rank score is negative mean log rank. Clip high log-ranks to the 90th percentile of genuine selection tokens using nearest-rank quantiles before averaging. Raw log-likelihood/log-rank ratio is sum of surprisal divided by sum of log rank. Clipped ratio caps surprisal and log rank separately at their genuine selection 90th percentiles. All scores orient high toward AI, following the paper; do not switch orientation by held results.
method.sources: Use dated publisher version pairs with explicit CC BY 4.0 in each JATS file. A replacement run of at most four sentences must have identical cardinality on both sides and immediate identical unique anchor sentences outside the run. Select one source-ordered aligned sentence per work. Use the genuine later sentence in the earlier context, preserving exact source positions of both original publisher versions and identical context for the AI variants.
method.split: Keep the initially qualified groups as selection and the subsequently acquired fixed-catalog-extension groups as held. Exact source fingerprints and recorded bylines are disjoint. If either cohort lacks two source groups or the held cohort lacks a generated case from either family, retain the pilot readout without advancement.
